senses.gloss: c. (כָּפָה, cmp. מטה כפויה s. v. כָּפָה) [an inverted vessel,] a low seat, a block with a concave top to sit upon; bolster, stool.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:17">Tosef. Sabb. XIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:17">XIV</cite>), 17 <he>וכ׳ חקוק בין כ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>כרפ׳</he>, Var. <he>כיפ׳</he>, corr. acc.) a block whether caved out &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 20:5">Kel. XX, 5</cite> <he>כ׳ שקבעו וכ׳</he> if one put a stool in the rubble of a wall (v. <cite ref="N00207"><he>נִדְבָּךְ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 11:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. XI, 6</cite> <he>כסא … בבנין</he>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 1</cite> [read:] <he>כ׳ חלקה שאין בה וכ׳</he> (v. R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 22:9">Kel. XXII, 9</cite>; ed. Zuck. <he>כיפת חלק</he>) a plain (not shaped) block which has not the height of &c. Y. Pes. VII, 28ᵈ bot. <he>בצק שעשאו כ׳</he> a mass of hardened dough which one made into a seating block. Ohol. XI, 3 <he>וכ׳ עבה</he> a thick carpet-cover of a seating block (cmp.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 11:10">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. XI, 10</cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:1:6">Y. Erub. VII, 24ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כ׳ שהדריגוה</he> a seating block into which steps were cut.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 12:2">Tosef. Ohol. XII, 2</cite> <he>שתי</he> … <he>וכ׳ ע״ג האבן</he> R. S. to ib. XI, 3 (ed. Zuck. a. oth. <he>וכי׳</he>) two stones above one another and a seating block on top &c.; a. e.—Pl. <he>כּוֹפְתִין</he>. Ib. in R. S. to Ohol l. c. (ed. Zuck. a. oth. <cite ref="K01023"><he>כָּפִיתִין</he></cite>).
